plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF

source_policy.db2_map: Preserve the local-store Map file bytes as the sole DB2 artifact and seal that component before terrain production.
source_policy.terrain_map: Use the v20 build-70450 available Map projection; materialized rows with a non-zero WDT FileDataID retain v20 source order. Unknown TACT sections remain unknown and are not inferred from bytes.
source_policy.terrain_omissions: Only the v20 MissingFile-only WDT/root-ADT omission policy applies. Terrain conversion outcomes remain producer-reported.
source_policy.identity_boundary: Verification parses the sealed Map artifact with read_map_70450().materialize(), compares declared/direct/copy/materialized counts and ordered selected (Map ID, WDT FileDataID) identities, ordinals, and outcomes against terrain coverage v3. This authenticates the stored Map projection, not whole-client Map completeness or source cryptographic authentication.

verification.verify_scope: offline package integrity, intrinsic DB2/MAPS formats, and independently re-derived available Map identity/order/WDT FileDataID/tile counts/materialized rows
verification.verify_links_scope: the same checks; no navigation or external package links are part of v24

acceptance_matrix.expect: admit only build 70450, mask 9, disabled keys, resident storage, one Map DB2 entry, terrain all or one map, and no navigation/map-domain/offmesh
reject every mask other than 9; admit only Db2|Terrain=9 for v24, while the v20 terrain profile remains mask 8; component bits are Db2=1, GameTables=2, Cameras=4, Terrain=8
offline verification re-reads sealed Map and rejects coverage whose ordered selected Map IDs, WDT FileDataIDs, ordinals, counts, section facts, or materialized-row count disagree
synthetic-only package exercises inspect, combined DB2 and v20 terrain extract/resume, offline verify, and sealed Map WDT FileDataID tampering rejection
refuse keys, scratch, navigation, map-domain and off-mesh before client/output work

legacy_preservation: v20 terrain and v23 selected navigation retain their existing plan, package and verification identities; v24 software admission transfers no prior real-client acceptance.
